title: Tailings Management Plan
description: Free Tailings Management Plan template for mining you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, monitoring programme, governance.
html:

DOCUMENT DETAILS
MINE / TAILINGS STORAGE FACILITY (TSF): ________RESPONSIBLE ENGINEER: ______________
FACILITY TYPE (dam / dry stack / paste): ________CONSEQUENCE CLASSIFICATION: ________
ISSUE DATE: ______________REVIEW DATE: ______________

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl measure
Embankment or dam failureDesign by qualified engineer, independent review, freeboard and stability monitoring
Overtopping / floodSpillway capacity, water balance, storm monitoring
Seepage and contamination of groundwaterLiner, drains, monitoring bores, water treatment
Dust from dry tailings surfacesDust suppression, revegetation, wind monitoring
Drowning, entrapment in tailingsAccess control, signage, rescue equipment, no solitary work
Pipeline leaks and spillsPipe inspection, leak detection, secondary containment

Monitoring Programme

ParameterMethodFrequencyTrigger levelAction
Pond water level and freeboardSurvey / gaugeDaily
Piezometer (pore pressure) readingsInstrumentsWeekly
Embankment settlement and crackingVisual and surveyWeekly
Seepage and groundwater qualitySamplingMonthly

Governance

☐ Responsible engineer and accountable executive appointed

☐ Operations, maintenance and surveillance manual in place

☐ Independent annual inspection and periodic safety review

☐ Emergency preparedness and response plan for dam break, tested with local community and

authorities

☐ Closure plan and financial provision documented
